FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Tailor & Stitch Boutique, we specialize in providing personalized tailoring and dressmaking services, focusing on custom garment creation and alterations for individual clients. Our operations include a dedicated team of skilled tailors who work closely with customers to design and fit clothing to their specific needs and preferences. We emphasize high-quality materials and craftsmanship, ensuring that each piece of clothing is tailored to perfection. Our boutique caters to a variety of needs, including alterations for formal wear, wedding attire, and bespoke menswear. We operate on an appointment-only basis to manage customer flow effectively, minimizing potential liability and enhancing the customer experience. To maintain our commitment to quality and service, we do not engage in self-service laundry operations, ensuring a focused and professional environment for all tailoring services provided.

As part of our tailoring services, we offer self-service coin-operated laundry facilities for customers to wash their garments before alteration or after repairs.
